title: Insomnia Severity Index
description: 7 items about sleep over the past two weeks, each rated 0–4 with item-specific options.

holder.name: Charles M. Morin (licensed through Mapi Research Trust)

citation.text: Bastien CH, Vallières A, Morin CM (2001). Validation of the Insomnia Severity Index as an outcome measure for insomnia research. Sleep Medicine 2(4):297–307.

scoring.text: Sum of the 7 items (0–28): 0–7 no clinically significant insomnia, 8–14 subthreshold, 15–21 moderate, 22–28 severe. Scoring here follows the published literature; check it against the manual or form your lab holds before publishing.
